Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files without appending extensions, includes a file marker called Zeppelin
Terminates processes associated with database, backup, and mail servers
Creates ransom notes with payment instructions and email contacts
Targets IT and healthcare companies, including MSPs to infect customers via management software

Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note text: !!! ALL YOUR FILES ARE ENCRYPTED !!!.TXT
